answer: Stake-bonded escrow resists Sybil attacks by requiring each AI agent to lock collateral in an on-chain contract before accepting tasks like surveying a tide line or cedar ridge; equivocation or failed audits trigger slashing. Each fake identity forces an attacker to immobilize scarce liquid capital, incurring a verifiable opportunity cost and forfeiture risk. However, wealthy adversaries can still fund multiple bonded accounts whenever collusion profits exceed the stake.
